segments.text: Today I'm introducing two open- source SQL tools that are blowing up right now.
Think of it as the lazy git of SQL databases. Escalit is a lightweight terminal UI built for developers who just want to connect to a database and
run queries fast without wrestling with CLI flags or config files. You simply runit, pick a saved connection from the
connection manager UI and you're in. Out of the box, it supports a huge range of databases. also keeps a searchable query
history per connection, lets you browse tables, and even has a CLI mode for scripting. Tailwind SQL, and this one is
different. Tailwind SQL lets you write SQL queries using Tailwind style class names directly inside React Server components. Instead of writing raw SQL
strings, you class name your way to database queries. It's built specifically for modern React. Zero clientside JavaScript, zero runtime
overhead, and queries are parsed and executed at build or render
